CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The PIT squib circuit (RH) consists of the airbag sensor assembly and seat belt pretensioner (RH). It causes the SAS to deploy when the SRS deployment conditions are satisfied. For details of the function of each component, see OPERATION on page RS-2. OTC 80131/64 is recorded when an open is detected in the PIT squib (RH) circuit.
